contents.name: 5. Some examples: T, K, and RP^n

Examples. (i) The cell complex C_*(T) has one basis element [v] in degree zero, two basis elements [e1] and [e2] in degree one, and one basis element [j] in degree two. All basis elements are cycles, hence H_*(T; Z) = C_*(T).
